messages:
D1 格 - 範: rule/regulation/standard (JMdict 格 rule, regulation, law; method) vs model; standard
D2 標 - 範: standard/criterion (mark; goal) vs standard
D3 基 - 範: basis/criterion vs standard
D4 倣 - 範: imitate/emulate a model vs model
D5 鏡 - 範: exemplar/model (mirror as paragon) vs model
D6 本 - 範: model/exemplar or origin vs model
D7 形 - 範: form/pattern (かた) vs model; pattern
D8 像 - 範: image/model vs model
D9 限 - 範: limit/bounds vs Daijisen secondary sense delimited frame (範囲)
D10 界 - 範: boundary vs delimited frame/bounds
D11 境 - 範: boundary; border vs delimited frame/bounds
D12 囲 - 範: enclose/range vs delimited frame (範囲)
D13 普 - 範: universal; widespread vs Daijisen sense spread widely (広範)
D14 広 - 範: wide vs spread widely (広範)
D15 度 - 範: degree/rule/measure vs standard; extent
D16 計 - 範: measure vs のり measurement/尺度 sense
D17 測 - 範: measure, gauge vs standard/measurement
D18 紀 - 範: rule/discipline vs standard; rule
D19 監 - 範: oversee/model (in packet family) vs model
D20 常 - 範: usual (English "standard" = usual/ordinary) vs standard
D21 様 - 範: manner/pattern vs model; pattern
D22 准 - 範: quasi-/conforming standard vs standard
D23 方 - 範: method/way vs model; standard (law/method parallel)
D24 種 - 範: kind/category vs category (範疇)
D25 均 - 範: level; average vs standard level
E1 般 - card note claims 般 includes scope or category; JMdict query empty, need card text
E2 師 - card note claims 師 includes model/exemplar in character dictionary; JMdict 師 lacks it
E3 規 - JMdict query empty; title standard; rule overlaps 範 title directly
E4 憲 - JMdict query empty; card note claims law/rules overlap
E5 儀 - exclusion basis (地球儀 model) needs card text to judge
E6 象 - card note claims modeling sense; check card text
E7 準 - card note claims standard/conforming to a model; direct title overlap
E8 式 - card note claims established form; check senses
E9 程 - card note claims degree or extent overlap with bounds sense
E10 域 - card note claims region or range overlap with bounds sense
